_comment: Minimal fixture for the SAM3X8E boot/connect smoke test. No analog_in / i2c / step_trigger entries - the test just verifies that the firmware boots through SystemInit (PMC_SR flipflop satisfies the MOSCXTS/MOSCSELS/MCKRDY/LOCKA busy-wait loops, EEFC FRDY is raised by the SAM4S_EEFC model since the EEFC register layout is family-uniform) and klippy completes its identify + clocksync handshake over the UART pty Renode exposes.
